note_en: These are the authors' reported numbers, not this run. They were measured on 10% of the PSG test set with GPT-4V, a model that is superseded and not reproducible at the version tested. Nothing a student runs here is comparable with them.
note_zh: 以下為該論文作者所報告之數值，並非本次執行結果。其量測範圍為 PSG 測試集之 10% 子集，所用模型為 GPT-4V，該模型現已為後繼者取代，且無法於受測版本重現。學員於本處執行所得之結果與其並不可比。
table3_reading_en: A five-row factorial over (O, P, E&Analysis), not a cumulative sequence. Row 1 is the headline: asked plainly, a frontier VLM scores R@20 = 0.032. It is not blind, it fails the string match. Rows 2 and 3 are single-component ablations, and together they carry the paper's most interesting unremarked fact: O alone gives 1.787 and P alone 2.079, but both together give 20.792, an order of magnitude beyond either and beyond their sum. Constraining one end of the triplet is nearly worthless; constraining both is transformative.
table3_reading_zh: 此為 (O, P, E&Analysis) 之五列因子設計，並非累加序列。第一列為關鍵：直接提問時，前沿 VLM 之 R@20 僅 0.032，其並非無法辨識場景，而是未能通過字串比對。第二、三列為單一元件之消融，兩者合觀即顯現該論文未加著墨而最值得注意之事實：僅提供 O 為 1.787，僅提供 P 為 2.079，兩者併用則為 20.792，較任一者高出一個數量級，亦高於兩者之和。僅約束三元組之一端幾無助益，同時約束兩端則具決定性作用。
table4_reading_en: N=5 is not uniformly better than N=3. Going from 3 to 5 improves R@20, mR@20, R@50 and mR@100, but degrades mR@50 (25.480 to 24.383) and R@100 (30.142 to 30.020). N=3 is therefore not dominated and the paper's recommendation rests on more than token cost. A view showing only the @20 column would teach the opposite of what the data says.
table4_reading_zh: N=5 並非全面優於 N=3。由 3 增至 5 時，R@20、mR@20、R@50 與 mR@100 均有提升，但 mR@50 由 25.480 降至 24.383，R@100 亦由 30.142 降至 30.020。故 N=3 並未被支配，該論文之建議亦不僅出於 token 成本之考量。僅呈現 @20 一欄之檢視方式，所傳達者與資料本身相反。
